nodes.label: CI job: Lint skills, commands, settings
CI job: Security guards (permissions, gitignore, manifests)
nodes.rationale: The template ships pre-approved Claude Code permissions and CLI code that every fork user executes, so PRs that widen settings.json permissions, weaken personal-data gitignore rules, or add package lifecycle scripts must fail. Honest stated limit: a PR can edit the workflow itself, so these guards catch accidents and casual attempts, not a determined author.

nodes.label: CI job: Dependency review (upstream PRs only)
nodes.rationale: Requires the repo Dependency graph, which forks never inherit and which may be disabled upstream. The graph is probed via the SBOM API first; if unavailable the job emits a warning and passes rather than hard-failing, following the same graceful-skip pattern used for optional tools.

nodes.label: CI job: Compile example CV and cover letter
nodes.rationale: Compile success and an extractable PDF text layer are asserted everywhere, but exact page-count and content assertions run only upstream because forks personalize cv/main_example.tex via /setup.

nodes.label: CI job: CLI checks (Bun typecheck + fixture tests)
CI job: Placeholder integrity (upstream template only)
nodes.rationale: Greps tracked template files for their placeholder tokens ([YOUR_NAME], [YOUR NAME], SETUP marker, [YOUR_PRIMARY_SKILLS]) so a missing token signals personal data was committed. Runs only on the upstream repo because forks legitimately replace the placeholders.

nodes.label: No Live Portal Requests in CI
nodes.rationale: Live portal smoke tests hit real job boards: network-flaky, and linkedin-search is personal-use only per its own ToS warning, so CI-automated requests would violate that. CI runs typechecks and checked-in fixture/mock suites only; live portal testing stays a local, on-demand step.

nodes.label: Fork-Friendly CI Design
nodes.rationale: Forks personalize CLAUDE.md, skill files and cv/main_example.tex via /setup, so repository-gated jobs (placeholder integrity, framework version guard, exact PDF assertions, dependency review) run only on MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search. Actions are pinned to commit SHAs and the token is read-only; branch protection and human review of workflow/settings diffs remain the real backstop.
